name: Garganta del Villar (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Garganta del Villar (a chequy field and a mountain on green).
history: Municipal flag of Garganta del Villar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Garganta del Villar arms — chequy and mountain
